related.title: IEEE 802.1Qav：信用回復時間
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學整窗最少超額需為0；2500通過必要檢查、4500至少超1500；2500仍須逐時序檢查瞬間突發。 qci_bucket_events.csv、桶餘額與超額/壅塞分離 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0 與變更 1500 excess bytes、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching aggregate minimum excess must be zero;2500 passes the necessary check while4500 exceeds by at least1500, and2500 still needs temporal burst analysis. qci_bucket_events.csv, token balance and excess/congestion separation Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0 and changed 1500 excess bytes, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學回復預算200 µs；−2000通過、−6000失敗；需先確認選用的規則允許這段時間按idleSlope回復。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching recovery budget200 microseconds:−2000 passes and−6000 fails; first verify the applicable rules permit accumulation over the interval.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成桶2000 bytes、補充10000 bytes/s、窗0.1 s；到達2500，擾動4500 bytes。 名義式 max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes；變更式 max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將到達分為10個10 ms片段並維護桶餘額，檢查結果與整窗上界的關係；突發時刻不同可改變實際丟棄量。

合成信用−2000 bits、idleSlope20 Mbit/s；擾動信用−6000 bits，斜率不變。 名義式 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us；變更式 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 每10 µs增加200 bits直到0，獨立求需10或30步；信用不得把byte與bit混為同量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic bucket2000 bytes, replenishment10000 bytes/s and0.1 s interval; arrivals2500 changed to4500 bytes. Nominal max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes; changed max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Simulate ten10 ms slices with bucket state and compare to the aggregate bound; different arrival timing can change actual dropped bytes.

Synthetic credit−2000 bits withidleSlope20 Mbit/s; change credit to−6000 bits at the same slope. Nominal 2000/20e6*1e6 = 100 us; changed 6000/20e6*1e6 = 300 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Add200 bits every10 microseconds until zero, requiring10 or30 steps; keep byte and bit credit units distinct.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Modbus RTU：字元時間與訊框靜默
related.titleEn: Modbus RTU: character times and frame silence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學整窗最少超額需為0；2500通過必要檢查、4500至少超1500；2500仍須逐時序檢查瞬間突發。 qci_bucket_events.csv、桶餘額與超額/壅塞分離 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0 與變更 1500 excess bytes、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching aggregate minimum excess must be zero;2500 passes the necessary check while4500 exceeds by at least1500, and2500 still needs temporal burst analysis. qci_bucket_events.csv, token balance and excess/congestion separation Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0 and changed 1500 excess bytes, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學固定靜默3 ms在9600不足、19200足夠；驗收須依實際字元格式與baud重新計算，禁止固定沿用一個數字。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. A teaching fixed3 ms gap fails at9600 and passes at19200; recalculate for actual character framing andbaud.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成桶2000 bytes、補充10000 bytes/s、窗0.1 s；到達2500，擾動4500 bytes。 名義式 max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes；變更式 max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將到達分為10個10 ms片段並維護桶餘額，檢查結果與整窗上界的關係；突發時刻不同可改變實際丟棄量。

合成11 bits/character，9600 baud；比較19200 baud，均以3.5字元計，並把界線與規格版本記錄。 名義式 3.5*11/9600*1000 = 4.01042 ms；變更式 3.5*11/19200*1000 = 2.00521 ms。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 先算單字元1.145833與0.572917 ms再乘3.5；從最後stop bit結束量到下一start bit開始。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic bucket2000 bytes, replenishment10000 bytes/s and0.1 s interval; arrivals2500 changed to4500 bytes. Nominal max(0,2500-2000-10000*0.1) = 0 excess bytes; changed max(0,4500-2000-10000*0.1) = 1500 excess bytes. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Simulate ten10 ms slices with bucket state and compare to the aggregate bound; different arrival timing can change actual dropped bytes.

Synthetic11 bits per character at9600 baud, compared with19200 using3.5 characters and explicitly documented boundary/version. Nominal 3.5*11/9600*1000 = 4.01042 ms; changed 3.5*11/19200*1000 = 2.00521 ms. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First derive character times1.145833 and0.572917 ms then multiply3.5; measure from the last stop-bit end to the next start-bit start.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
